Aqua]] }} '''Off Course with Corsola''' (Japanese: '''VS サニーゴ''' ''VS {{tt|Sunnygo|Corsola}}''), titled '''VS Corasola'''{{sic}} in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 121st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At Professor Oak's Second Research Center, {{adv|Professor Oak}} receives the {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} {{adv|Crystal}} recently caught, along with her {{p|Smoochum|Chumee}}. The next morning, Crystal heads to [[Union Cave]] to go to the west side of [[Johto]]. While traveling through the cave, she flashes back to {{adv|Bill}} informing her that the same species from [[Kanto]] and [[Johto]] might look slightly different, and therefore {{adv|Professor Oak}} would like her to collect them again. Back in the present, Crystal spots a {{p|Magneton}}, which doesn't live in the cave. Suddenly, three more Magneton appear and surround Crystal and [[Megaree]], who then drop them in a {{wp|submarine}}. Afterwards, [[Lt. Surge]] approaches the submarine but is disappointed to discover that his Magneton did not get any [[wild Pokémon]]. Lt. Surge then enters the submarine to travel to [[Azalea Town]]. He leaves through a secret passage but gets stuck on a reef of {{p|Corsola}}. Crystal comes to and surprises Lt. Surge when he realizes she is on board. Briefing her on the situation, she figures out that she has to capture the leader. [[Natee]] creates a current with {{m|Psychic}}, which lifts them up. After they are out of the water, Natee defeats the leader with Psychic, which Crystal captures with a [[Lure Ball]]. As compensation, Lt. Surge gives her a ride to [[Olivine City]] on the [[S.S. Aqua]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Crystal}} is captured by [[Lt. Surge]]'s {{p|Magneton}}, who drops her in Lt. Surge's submarine. * Lt. Surge's submarine gets stuck on a herd of Corsola. * Crystal gets the submarine unstuck from the herd of Corsola. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Quagsire}} * {{p|Phanpy}} * {{p|Yanma}} * {{p|Corsola}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Crystal}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Bill}} (flashback) * [[Lt.
